name: perfectvector-monorepo
description: AI-assisted raster to clean SVG vectorization service, engine and MCP plugin

scripts.build:web: pnpm run fixtures && pnpm run samples && pnpm --filter @perfectvector/web build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:web
scripts.verify:all: pnpm run verify && pnpm run verify:strokes && pnpm run verify:real && pnpm run verify:mcp && pnpm run verify:batch && pnpm run verify:web

pnpm.//: sharp arrives both directly (MCP image decoding) and transitively via Next.js. Without this approval pnpm exits non-zero on every `pnpm run`, which breaks the verification scripts.
